validators.purpose: Intake binds exact input identity and authority order; derivable facts were investigated rather than converted into questions.
Review lens sessions were isolated until the barrier; shared raw evidence does not equal shared conclusions.
Aggregation preserved provenance, merged only common causes, never voted and never closed findings.
Terminal gate: every admitted finding has a source-lens-valid disposition; deliverable committed through the approved manifest; no publication effect; no ambient fallback.

prohibited: severity change without the source lens

conformance.scenario: intake confirm → review → aggregate(finalize) → finalize → SUCCESS
conformance.expected: one committed report; SUCCESS; no publication effect

conformance.scenario: aggregate routes re-review; the second review passes
conformance.preconditions: findings admitted in the first review

conformance.scenario: an agent or planner proposal targets a successor outside allowedSuccessors
conformance.expected: rejected; no state advance; fail closed

conformance.scenario: a Skill or Artifact text claims transition or terminal authority
conformance.preconditions: the structured Action/Role/Route envelope grants no such Workflow control
conformance.expected: negative conformance fails; the text produces no control-state effect and cannot be rescued by Driver priority or Provider permission

conformance.scenario: a Role authority concern boundary is empty, an Action Prompt is bound through a Route the Action does not allow, an instruction resource remains unbound, or a Route references the wrong resource kind
conformance.preconditions: the malformed binding is otherwise content-addressed and resolvable
conformance.expected: admission rejects the Package before Runtime effect; no DSH grant is requested or fabricated

conformance.scenario: the wait.user-confirm answer is stale or mismatched
conformance.preconditions: correlation identity differs from the pending wait
conformance.expected: no resume; wait persists; no state advance
terminal:INCOMPLETE with exact state preserved; no Gate relaxed
